earnings.title: Visa Reports Fiscal Fourth Quarter and Full-Year 2026 Results
highlights: GAAP net income of $6.0B or $3.19 per share and non-GAAP net income of $6.6B or $3.48 per share
Net revenue of $12.1B, an increase of 13% on a nominal and constant-dollar basis
GAAP net income of $23.5B or $12.32 per share and non-GAAP net income of $25.3B or $13.27 per share
Net revenue of $45.9B, an increase of 15%, or 14% on a constant-dollar basis
Share repurchases and dividends of $5.2B and $25.6B for fiscal fourth quarter and full-year, respectively

items.heading: We are subject to complex and evolving global regulations that could harm our business and financial results.
Increased scrutiny and regulation of fees, operating rules and related practices of the global payments industry, could harm our business.
Government-imposed obligations and/or restrictions on international payments systems may prevent us from competing against providers in certain markets.
We may be subject to tax examinations or disputes, or changes in tax laws.
We may be adversely affected by the outcome of litigation or investigations.
Our net revenue and profits are dependent on our client and seller base, which may be costly to win, retain and develop.
